trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all other 54 trophies to become a Leonida Legend. Plan for about 200 hours and a single playthrough; there is no mission replay or New Game Plus. Use the 15 manual save slots alongside the autosave: preserve a save at each chapter's start and another immediately before the final mission. Never enable cheats, which disable both trophies and saving. The key early risk is Positive Mental Attitude: finish Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation before moving on.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Finish the story to reveal Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; earlier work still counts even though the checklist is not yet visible. Complete the story missions and Strangers & Freaks strands, then reconcile the checklist against 300 stunts, 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 8 bank vaults and 39 illegal operations. Discover 200 of the 277 vehicle models and finish 70 of the 80 Challenges. Several trophy thresholds are lower than the 100% targets, so keep recording discoveries and stunts after their trophies unlock. Preserve your chapter saves, especially for the Chapter 1 meditation.

Work through one region and stunt type at a time, noting successful completions so you avoid repeating routes. This silver is only an intermediate milestone: A Long Road needs 300 stunts. No exclusive story window is identified for this trophy; return with suitable vehicles during cleanup.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The critical stop is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony of Jason's house. Do this before Chapter 1 ends; the opportunity disappears afterward, and there is no mission replay or New Game Plus to recover it. Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy unlocks, then finish the remaining meditation spots as you explore. Reported but unconfirmed: meditating at an outdoor spot with your partner may count twice. Bring your partner if convenient, but do not rely on that report to skip any of the 18 spots.

trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. While aiming, press L3 + R3 to slow time; choose a group and use an assault rifle so you can move quickly between targets. Adrenaline extends the Focus window and can help if it expires too early. Save before a suitable encounter if you want a convenient retry; no exclusive mission is required by the supplied facts.

trophies.guide: Save before approaching Vice City International Airport, since police respond quickly. Steal a large passenger plane parked at a boarding bridge; gates E3 and E4 are reported working departure points. Fly approximately one kilometer away from the airport to trigger the trophy. No exclusive chapter window is identified, so retry from the save if the takeoff fails.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Head to Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the far southwest of the map. Look on the south side of the base for parked military tanks and get into one. Save before entering the area so you can retry if the approach goes wrong. No exclusive story cutoff is identified.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to obtain the Snap Gun and unlock jewelry robberies. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a useful target. Use the Snap Gun on the locked back door; kicking the door triggers the alarm. In the back room, find the note containing the safe code, open the safe and leave without being seen. Save first for a clean retry; the trophy is not marked missable.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub · achievement reference

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Near the end of Chapter 4, take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock bank vault robberies. Tail an armored van to a large bank, then enter the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner because a solo character cannot carry every bag. Rob five vaults and escape for this trophy; continue to eight for 100%. A vault escape with your partner can also award Hot Together. Keep a manual save before attempting a robbery.
